description: Create ONE reusable fictional character with a provider. This SPENDS CREDITS: read soclo_actors_list for the live offer, show it to the owner and get their yes first, then pass ownerApprovedPrice: true with the offer’s exact expectedCredits and pricingVersion. The host writes the name and description (spec). Origin soclo_generated makes a new character; owner_imported turns an exact current owned Brand Kit assetId/assetVersion into one. Active account rights and an image-specific fictional declaration are both required for an import: ask the owner for the exact fictional declaration on a new source, and omit ownerRightsDeclaration only when reusing an already attested unchanged source. Preserve original request fields on replay. Never invent owner words. A real person must use Soclo’s verified-person flow, never this fictional route. Pass a stable clientRequestId. A pending or uncertain creation may already have spent credits: keep the same ID and reconcile with soclo_actors_list or Soclo; never start another purchase automatically.
